label: Вернуться
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for вернуться (to return, come back).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. Вернуться is perfective and reflexive, so 'вернусь' is the non-past 1sg form with future meaning, on stem верн- plus -усь. The imperfective partner is возвращаться.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Вернёшься' shows the stressed -ёшься ending on stem верн-. As a perfective non-past it asks about one completed act of coming back.

missions.phrase: Он вернётся к нам через час.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Вернётся' is the он-form ending in -ётся. The perfective marks a single return at a fixed time, unlike the ongoing возвращается from возвращаться.

missions.phrase: Мы вернёмся в этот город снова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Вернёмся' carries the -ёмся ending on верн-. The perfective frames one future act of returning rather than a habitual practice.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Вернётесь' trains the respectful вы-form with -ётесь on верн-, the particle becoming -сь after the vowel. It asks about one act of going back.

missions.phrase: Они вернутся домой только в субботу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Вернутся' closes the non-past ladder with the -утся ending on верн-. The perfective marks a single future return fixed to Saturday.

missions.phrase: Он вернулся с фронта живым и здоровым.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Вернулся' is the masculine singular past of perfective вернуться, with the suffix -ну- and the reflexive -ся after -л. It reports one completed homecoming.

missions.phrase: Она вернулась поздно и сразу легла.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Вернулась' adds the feminine -ась ending. The perfective past names a single finished return, here chained to the next perfective action 'легла'.

missions.phrase: Туристы вернулись в отель к обеду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Вернулись' is the plural past ending in -ись, completing the past forms. The perfective marks one completed return of the group by lunchtime.

missions.phrase: Вернись скорее, мы все тебя ждём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Вернись' is the informal command form on stem верн- with the reflexive -ся, urging one person to come back. The clause 'мы тебя ждём' gives an emotional reason.
